_comment: Readiness ('basics first') framework. 'match' = start of the indicator name in the workbooks. Score 0 at 'zero_at', 100 at 'benchmark'. Indicators with a 'gate_floor' form the basic-service gate: pass all = ready to scale smart services; >= gate_targeted = targeted smart use; >= gate_fix = fix foundations first; below = hold new smart spending.

benchmarks.label: Piped water to homes
benchmarks.action: Give every household a tap connection

benchmarks.label: Water per person
benchmarks.action: Augment water source and treatment capacity

benchmarks.label: Hours of water supply
benchmarks.action: Move towards 24×7 supply: zoning, leak control, bulk metering

benchmarks.label: Sewer network coverage
benchmarks.action: Extend sewers; septage management where unsewered

benchmarks.label: Sewage treated
benchmarks.action: Add and upgrade sewage treatment plants

benchmarks.label: Door-to-door waste collection
benchmarks.action: Collect segregated waste from every household

benchmarks.label: Waste sent to landfill
benchmarks.action: Process waste scientifically and clear legacy dumpsites

benchmarks.label: Hours of power supply
benchmarks.action: Strengthen feeders and the distribution network

benchmarks.label: Toilet access in slums
benchmarks.action: Provide toilets in every slum and EWS area

benchmarks.label: Drains in flood-prone zones
benchmarks.action: Build storm-water drains in every flood-prone ward

benchmarks.label: Doctors per 100,000 people
benchmarks.action: Add doctors and urban health centres

benchmarks.label: Population living in slums
benchmarks.action: Upgrade slums in place and rehouse where unsafe

benchmarks.label: Students per teacher
benchmarks.action: Recruit teachers to reach 30 students per teacher

benchmarks.label: School dropout rate
benchmarks.action: Cut dropouts through retention and transport support

benchmarks.label: Roads with footpaths
benchmarks.action: Build continuous footpaths on all main roads

benchmarks.label: Population served by metro/BRT
benchmarks.scheme: PM e-Bus Sewa first, then MRTS
benchmarks.action: Expand city buses to 40–60 per lakh before new metro lines

benchmarks.label: Barrier-free public buildings
benchmarks.action: Retrofit ramps, lifts and tactile paths in public buildings

benchmarks.label: Annual air quality index
benchmarks.action: Cut road dust, waste burning and vehicle emissions

benchmarks.label: Open space per person
benchmarks.action: Add parks and open space towards 9 m² per person

benchmarks.label: Buildings with rainwater harvesting
benchmarks.action: Enforce rainwater harvesting in all buildings

benchmarks.label: Waste recycled or recovered
benchmarks.action: Scale material recovery and composting

benchmarks.label: Population reached by early warning
benchmarks.action: Extend SMS, siren and app alerts to all at-risk areas
